City of Chicago
                                                                     O2021-3969
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 9/14/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Tunney (44)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-G at 3504 N Clark St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B3-3,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-G in the
area bound by:

       North Clark Street; West Cornelia Avenue; the alley next southwest of and parallel to
       North Clark Street; and, a line 55 feet northwest of and parallel to West Cornelia Avenue

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




Common Address:
3504 North Clark Street
